intro.title: Flooring Services
intro.mainText: Quality flooring changes the entire feel of a space. VV Renovation installs flooring with attention to preparation, leveling, clean layout and long-lasting results for homes and commercial interiors.
intro.secondaryText: We work with homeowners, designers and builders across the Greater Vancouver Area (Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), Langley (Township)) to deliver clean, reliable and professional flooring installation.

items.question: What types of flooring do you install?
items.answer: We install hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, vinyl, microcement flooring, and provide self-leveling for proper surface preparation.

items.question: Do you prepare the subfloor before installation?
items.answer: Yes, proper surface preparation is essential. We inspect, repair, and level the subfloor to ensure durability and a clean, long-lasting result.

items.question: How long does flooring installation take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the size of the area and the type of flooring. Most residential flooring projects take between 1 and 5 days.

items.question: Which flooring option is best for my space?
items.answer: It depends on your budget, lifestyle, and design preferences. We help you choose the right material based on durability, maintenance, and overall look.

items.question: Is flooring installation suitable for commercial spaces?
items.answer: Yes, we install flooring for both residential and commercial interiors, including offices, retail spaces, and rental properties.

items.question: Do you work across the Greater Vancouver Area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide flooring installation services across Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey and surrounding areas.
